authority: Canonical task statuses and evidence reconciled after merge by a single integration owner; authored parallel PRs may use docs/changes/<TASK-ID>-<topic>.md instead of concurrent edits to shared progress. Historical source plans remain scope definitions.
rules: merged requires a concrete PR link
accepted requires product owner or direct art/device approval and evidence
never infer task completion from green CI or presence of a document
evidence must be updated when changing status
repo main may advance; always verify merged PR state before claiming current status
